newsitem.title: FRANCE: TPS head repeats 300,000 subscriber target end-'97.
newsitem.headline: TPS head repeats 300,000 subscriber target end-'97.

text.p: Patrick Le Lay, chairman of French digital satellite television service Television Par Satellite (TPS), said on Monday the service expects to have 300,000 subscribers by the end of 1997.
Le Lay, speaking at a news conference at the MIP television trade fair here, said TPS has over 116,000 subscribers currently.
It has ordered 100,000 extra decoders from electronics company Sagem, which brings its overall decoder order to 260,000 units, he said.

TPS is run by French private terrestrial channel TF1, of which Le Lay is also chairman. TF1 owns 25 percent of TPS, while private terrestrial channel M6-Metropole TV and its parents control 50 percent. The remaining 25 percent is owned by public channel France Television and telephone operator France Telecom.
